pages.title: A controlled contamination
pages.text:
A controlled contamination
The same forty test rows are retained while training includes earlier repeats from their
groups.
Training and test rows diﬀer, but their ﬁngerprints reveal shared identity.

pages.title: Recognition is not new-group prediction
pages.text:
Recognition is not new-group prediction
The contaminated nearest neighbor attains perfect accuracy on this constructed sample.
The result reﬂects access to the same group ﬁngerprints, not perfect population
discrimination.

pages.title: The target distribution remains an assumption
pages.text:
The target distribution remains an assumption
Holding out people does not automatically hold out sites, calendar periods or acquisition
devices.
Prediction-time availability and the group-generating distribution remain part of
the statistical problem.
